title.narrative: Extended social protection coverage and established social protection floor

description.narrative: The Government of Iraq has put social protection as key government priority; it is strongly positioned in the National Development Programme (2022) and the Kurdistan Regional Government’s Vision document. In view of these priorities, the ILO envisages to enhance access of private sector workers and their families to comprehensive and sustainable social security and active labour market programmes. The ILO is also planning to boost the capacity of Civil Society Organizations to contribute to the national social protection agenda through its tripartite constituents dialogue mechanisms.
